activity.title: Best team to join for anything tech x law

YC is unreasonably good at one thing: getting the people who are early to something into the same room before the industry catches up. The Startup Internship Expo on August 15 in SF is one of those rooms, and I'll be there hiring. Koyal (YC F25) is the AI film company. Most AI video is slop and everyone knows it. We're building the part that isn't: a script goes in, a real film comes out, with characters, worlds, and continuity that hold across the whole runtime. Come find me if you orchestrate agents and models without being handed a spec, have worked with diffusion, generative video, CV, or ML systems, and care about the application as much as the model. Taste is a technical skill here. Join the foremost AI lab built for filmmaking built by researchers out of Meta , Carnegie Mellon University , and MIT Media Lab . If you think AI cinema is a dead end, come tell me why on the 15th. https://yc.link/r/X8WQhnAN
Last night I read an insane tweet about GPT escaping its sandbox in 2029. Sent it to the team on our slack #filmmaking channel with zero context. Woke up to this. I have no words.
We just benchmarked Flux 3 by Black Forest Labs on filmarena.ai They're one of the most coherent image to video models out now. But interestingly that doesn't make them the most preferred.

As a CEO in SF, I think it's my responsibility to show my team the outside world. So I took my team to explicitly touch grass at south park commons. then we filmed a music video about what we accomplished throughout the week. catch a cameo by our mascot in the end.

I can't believe how many different companies are competing to take my notes. I had to uninstall notion because it kept fighting circleback. Then Granola entered the fray and seemed like the best. Good UI + it gave you the meeting link before the meeting. Now, Wispr Flow has entered the chat. Does exactly what Granola does but bundled with their existing product. Idk as a consumer if I have loyalty here. Interesting how these companies are approaching this.
Rejections shape you. Here I describe how rejections led me to YC. Fun watch!

We are hosting a free screening of Spider-Man: Brand New Day for founders in SF on August 12. Koyal (YC F25) presents the first edition of Birdhouse Cinema 🎥 , with Chargebee . Every founder here is Peter Parker. Broke, behind on rent, hoping the world remembers their name. Koyal makes films with AI. Felt right to put one on a big screen. If Corgi can have a cafe, we can bring the cinema. Apply below. Tell us why you want your story on the big screen 👇

PSA: there's a site called koyal [dot] org running an "AI-enabled" crypto trading product under our name and logo. Enough people sent it to me this week that I want to be unambiguous: That is not us. Koyal (YC F25) has nothing to do with crypto or trading. Our only website is koyal.ai . Please don't engage with it. Don't download their software, don't connect a wallet, don't share keys or funds. We can't vouch for anything on that site. We've documented everything and will pursue this seriously if the infringement continues. (lowkey a compliment that the brand is worth copying. still not the kind of flattery we want.) If it shows up in your feed, report it. And if you're ever unsure whether something is really us: koyal.ai , nothing else.

I’ve finally formally completed my PhD from International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad (IIITH) , a day before turning 30, so I’ll count that as a win. 😛 These years have been some of the most fulfilling of my life, and I owe a huge part of that to my advisors, CV Jawahar sir and Vinay sir, for their guidance throughout. One of my biggest fears at the start of my PhD was whether any work I’d be part of would ever actually be used by anyone. Therefore, the best part of my IIITH journey was being able to continue my research into sync. labs , now a 40+ member team doing multi million dollars in annual revenue. Grateful to everyone who’s been part of this chapter. Excited for what’s next 🤞
